query:
UPDATE "Client" AS c
           SET "uploadTraffic" = c."uploadTraffic" + v.upload,
               "downloadTraffic" = c."downloadTraffic" + v.download,
               "usedTraffic" = c."usedTraffic" + v.upload + v.download,
               "lastActiveAt" = $4, "updatedAt" = $4
           FROM UNNEST($1::text[], $2::bigint[], $3::bigint[]) AS v(id, upload, download)
           WHERE c.id = v.id
           RETURNING c.id, c."usedTraffic" AS used_traffic,
                     c."trafficLimit" AS traffic_limit
